description: This file defines the NetworkDays class which provides functionality to calculate the number of working days between two dates in a spreadsheet context, considering weekends and holidays. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine.

classes.name: NetworkDays
classes.description: Contains methods to calculate the number of working days between two dates, considering weekends and holidays, as used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Calculates the number of working days between start and end dates, optionally excluding specified holidays. Supports array inputs for batch calculations.

methods.name: calcStartDow
methods.description: Calculates the day of the week for the start date, adjusted to a Monday-start week.

methods.name: calcEndDow
methods.description: Calculates the day of the week for the end date, adjusted for weekend considerations.

methods.name: calcPartWeekDays
methods.description: Calculates the number of working days in a partial week based on start and end day of week.

methods.name: applySign
methods.description: Adjusts the result sign based on the chronological order of start and end dates.
